## Simulation study

### setting 1

a mixture whose two components are clearly separated. 

```{r}
#generate a dataset

set.seed(1)

n <- 100
allocation <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.7)
separate_data <- allocation*rnorm(n, -2, 1) + (1 - allocation)*rnorm(n, 2, 1)

```

#### Initialisation $\mu_1 < \mu_2$

```{r}
source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation <- list(
      mu_1    = 1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

separate_gibbs = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation)

mu_1_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs, function (x) x$sigma2)

```



```{r}

#png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_init1_trace.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot(mu_1_vector, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[1]), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1])))

plot(mu_2_vector, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[2]),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[2])))

plot(pi_vector, type = "l", ylab = expression(pi), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi)))

plot(sigma2_vector, type = "l", ylab = expression(sigma^2), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2)))


#dev.off()

```


```{r}

png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_init1_acf.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector, main = "ACF: mu_1")
acf(mu_2_vector, main = "ACF: mu_2")
acf(pi_vector, main = "ACF: pi")
acf(sigma2_vector, main = "ACF: sigma2")

dev.off()

```

### setting 2

A mixture whose not clearly separated

```{r}

#generate a dataset

set.seed(1)

n <- 100
allocation <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.7)
separate_data <- allocation*rnorm(n, -0.5, 1) + (1 - allocation)*rnorm(n, 0.5, 1)

```

#### Initialisation $\mu_1 < \mu_2$

```{r}

set.seed(1)

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 1,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation <- list(
      mu_1    = 1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 2
    )

separate_gibbs_1 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation)
separate_gibbs_2 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation, allow_switching=FALSE)

mu_1_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$mu_2)
mu_1_vector_2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs_2, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector_2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs_2, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$pi)
pi_vector_2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs_2, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$sigma2)

```

```{r}

png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting2_init1_trace.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot(mu_1_vector, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[1]), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1])), col="blue", ylim=c(-2, 2))

lines(mu_2_vector, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[2]),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[2])), col="orange")

plot(mu_1_vector_2, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[1]), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1])),col="blue", ylim=c(-2, 2))

lines(mu_2_vector_2, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[2]),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[2])),col="orange")
plot(pi_vector, type="l")
plot(pi_vector_2, type="l")
plot()

dev.off()

```


```{r}

png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting2_init1_acf.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector, main = "ACF: mu_1")
acf(mu_2_vector, main = "ACF: mu_2")
acf(pi_vector, main = "ACF: pi")
acf(sigma2_vector, main = "ACF: sigma2")

dev.off()

```

## Aplication to the faithful dataset
```{r}

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 1,
  beta_0 = 1
)

mean <- mean(faithful$eruptions)
std <- sd(faithful$eruptions)
preprocessed_data <- (faithful$eruptions - mean)/ std

```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
faithful_gibbs <- gibbs_sampler(preprocessed_data, 100, 100, hyperparams)
```
